headline: Minecraft - the best-selling game ever
title: The Story of Minecraft | Notch, Mojang, 300 Million Copies | Gaming Facts
video_script: Minecraft was created by Markus Persson, known as Notch. Its first version came out in two thousand nine, and the full release in two thousand eleven. Today it is the best-selling video game of all time, with more than three hundred million copies sold. In two thousand fourteen, Microsoft bought Mojang, the company behind Minecraft.
